message.reasoning:
The user wants to find out the rewards for playing Fortnite on Playstation platform with different missions and trophies. We need to use the function game_rewards_get. Provide arguments: game="Fortnite", platform="Playstation". They didn't specify mission or trophy; we can default to empty strings. But they want "different missions and trophies" - maybe we should list multiple calls? The instruction says "When calling a function, you must provide a JSON object as the argument." So we can call the function once with mission='' and trophy=''. That will return info about all rewards? Or we might need to call it multiple times for each mission/trophy combination. But the function signature indicates mission and trophy optional. If omitted, returns info about all rewards? The description: "Retrieve information about different types of rewards that you can receive when playing a certain game." It doesn't say what happens if mission or trophy omitted. Likely returns all rewards. So we can call once.

We should respond with the function call.
